cohort: 27 healthy, male, term neonates born of elective cesarean delivery
finding: Within 14 hours of birth, cardiac autonomic adjustments are characterized by an increase in parasympathetic activity in healthy, male, term neonates born by elective cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Within 14 hours of birth, cardiac autonomic adjustments are characterized by an increase in parasympathetic activity in healthy, male, term neonates born by elective cesarean delivery.
